Hey Denver!

JUNKKR is a dedicated team that's proud to serve all your junk removal needs. Whether you have to get rid of furniture, appliances, tech, or other unneeded items, we have got you covered. We'll arrive on time at your home, office, or complex and remove your junk efficiently and responsibly, guaranteed. We donate as many items as possible, and transport the rest to reputable recycling plants and landfills, so you can have peace of mind that your junk is disposed of carefully and intentionally. As a customer, you can count on friendly, efficient service — no worries, no fluff. We strive to give you the best junk removal experience, the JUNKKR experience.

Got Questions?

We've Got Answers

What Are Your Prices?▾
Our minimum starting price is $150. We charge by load size, and every load is different. We offer free quotes for all customers so you know exactly what your removal will cost — no hidden fees, ever. Simply submit a short description of the items, how many there are, and a few photos for the most accurate quote.
Where Does The Junk Go?▾
After we remove your junk, it's on us to dispose of it safely and responsibly. We first donate as much as possible to local thrift stores so items can be reused — contributing to the community and a cleaner earth. Unusable items are sent to local recycling centers or professional landfills.
Will You Take My Junk?▾
Yes! We accommodate as many junk categories as possible so you don't run into surprises. We remove appliances, furniture, demolition debris, electronics, and miscellaneous items. We cannot take hazardous materials, organic waste, or chemicals.
When Can You Come?▾
We run a flexible schedule and operate six days a week, conducting appointments from 9 AM to 6 PM. Contact us to check available times — we'll do our best to work around your schedule!
